current_evidence: Not verified. The shared WebFetch budget for the session ran out (proxy HTTP 403) before any Coventry page could be read. Searches show the 17-3-25 checklist (file 44597), an older 'validation-checklist' (file 34970), an HTML checklist page (coventry.gov.uk/planningchecklist) and a council 'LVLconsultation' page. Whether that consultation led to the 17-3-25 version or to a newer list could not be confirmed.

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank, and the row is marked 'Undated', although the document's own title gives 17 March 2025 ('validation checklist 17 3 25'). The date should be recorded, ideally checked against the text of the document.

Householder, Outline, Advertisement consent and Lawful development certificate are all recorded as having no local requirements, but Grokbot's own extracts show requirements that apply to them. Examples: 5.6 Bat Survey (minor residential development involving demolition or roof space), 4.2 Heritage Statement (applications affecting a listed building or in a Conservation Area), 2.1 Block/site plan ('All planning applications for built development'), elevation drawings for 'existing/proposed certificate of lawful development (where relevant)', and section drawings for 'advertisement consent'.
issues.evidence: tab_items: 'Applications for existing/proposed certificate of lawful development (where relevant) Elevation drawings should be drawn to scale (1:50 or 1:100)...'; 'Applications for advertisement consent Section drawings should be drawn to scale...'

issues.detail: Air Quality Assessment and Block/site plan are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' because their triggers mention 'change of use'. Those triggers refer to planning applications for change of use, not prior approval. The remaining 23 rows are placed under 'Full planning' as 'INFERRED' even where the trigger is site-based (Arboricultural, Lighting, Flue/ventilation) and would apply to householder and outline applications too.
issues.evidence: '2.1 Block/site plan All planning applications for built development or change of use;'

issues.detail: Several requirements are matched to another requirement's text. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' uses the tree AIA/AMS text. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' uses the 6.5 Flue and ventilation text. 'Transport Assessment' uses the Air Quality report text. 'Existing and proposed site levels / sections' uses tree root protection area text. 'Floor plans / Elevations' and 'Photographs' use external wall insulation text.
issues.evidence: Transport Assessment: 'criteria for Transport Assessment A comprehensive report to enable full consideration of the impact of the proposal on the air quality of the area.'; Schedule of works: '(AIA), Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) and Tree Protection Plan.'

issues.detail: Several triggers are cut off or missing. BNG ends 'All planning applications:- 1.'. FRA ends mid-sentence ('appropriate to the scale and nature of the'), with no flood-zone or site-size condition. Noise ('must be prepared by a qualified acoustician') and Drainage give no trigger. Fire Statement is mostly broken gov.uk URL fragments and does not state the 18m / 7-storey threshold. Travel Plan gives only the first threshold ('A1 food retail up between 250-800 sq.m;'), which also uses the old A1 use class. Construction Management Plan uses demolition-only text.

Some items numbered in the checklist are not captured as rows. For example, an archaeology requirement is suggested by the archaeology guidance link just before 4.5 Structural survey, but there is no Archaeological Assessment row. 4.2 Heritage Statement is captured only under Listed building consent, not under Full planning or Householder. Only 30 items were captured from a list with sections numbered up to at least 7.1. The full contents could not be compared with the source in this run.
issues.evidence: Structural Survey excerpt begins '...vation_and_archaeology/454/archaeology/1 4.5 Structural survey'

issues.detail: Grokbot combined the 17-3-25 PDF with the HTML checklist page, and the two give different Air Quality triggers. The PDF says applications with relevant exposure above statutory limits or meeting the DfT TA threshold; the web page says new build, conversion or change of use affecting the air quality action plan. One of the two versions may be out of date, and the workbook does not say which it follows.
issues.evidence: PDF: '5.1 Air Quality Assessment All applications where there may be relevant exposure to pollutant concentrations above statutory limits'; web page: 'An air quality assessment is needed for all new build, conversion or change of use proposals...'

issues.detail: All four 'Submission rules' tab items are Planning Portal file-size instructions, not validation requirements. They are duplicated (the PDF and web page versions say the same thing), and one is a fragment ('Any documents in excess of 10 Mb should be split. 1.').
issues.evidence: 'All applications should be submitted through the planning portal, where there is a document size limit of 5Mb.' (x2)

summary: Grokbot's 17 March 2025 checklist link could not be read or confirmed as current because the session's fetch budget ran out. A council 'LVLconsultation' page exists and should be checked for a newer list. Grokbot's extraction leaves the date blank, records no local requirements for Householder, Outline, Advertisement or LDC even though its own extracts show some, and matches several triggers to the wrong requirement (transport to air quality text, flood sequential test to flue text).
